counting_rules: All-torrent aggregate H3r8 counts use the native post-aggregation downloader threshold of three.
Torrent ranks and content cohorts use per-torrent retained geography; their total differs from the aggregate.
Daily/weekly memberships are not additive to cumulative memberships. H3r5 cohort sums are membership-days.
Flags are excluded separately and local/world denominators use the same exclusion.
Fixture IP unions are already de-duplicated within a fixture and observed-age window; never unique viewers.
